headline: Trane Technologies Reports Strong Second Quarter Results; Raises Full-Year Revenue and EPS Guidance
summary: Trane Technologies plc (NYSE:TT), a global climate innovator, today reported diluted earnings per share (EPS) from continuing operations of $4.20 for the second quarter of 2026. Adjusted continuing EPS was $4.31, up 11 percent.
